meta.purpose: Agent-oriented map of four ALM Works Structure formula columns (Expr) that render QA workflow buttons and statuses on Epic rows. Describes shared Jira parameters, child-issue filters, and intentional or accidental behavioral differences between snippets.
meta.live_sync_note: v04 RA/TC/CR/Validation and qa-end-date v1 match Structure board 603 as of 2026-05-26 operator paste.

version_history_dir: automation/structure/roadmap-columns/versions — formula bodies per version; metadata.json + README.md at bundle root.

epic_aborted_skip.applies_when: `this.status = "Aborted"` — evaluated immediately after Epic type gate on all four columns.
epic_aborted_skip.count_source: `abortMatches`: same lane semantics as each column’s `tctasks` filter but **without** excluding child `Aborted` status, so aborted Epics still count existing lane tickets.
epic_aborted_skip.display: `Skipped` when `abortMatches.SIZE()` is 0; otherwise `Skipped ([SIZE|[url]])` wiki link where `SIZE` clicks to `issues/?jql=`…
structure_expr_notes: Keep lane `with abortMatches` immediately after Epic gate (do not nest `with` under `IF Aborted`).
Aborted UX: prefer `IF this.status = "Aborted" AND abortMatches.SIZE() = 0` then `ELSE: IF this.status = "Aborted": CONCAT(…)`.

CONCAT for Skipped (n|url): outer form is CONCAT("Skipped (", "[", SIZE, "|", CONCAT("https://…", this.key, "tail"), "])"). Exactly one ) closes the inner CONCAT before the comma — an extra ) causes parse failure.
jql_notes: JQL scopes by Epic Link field `cf[15471]` (same id used in CreateIssueDetails URLs) plus lane filters. Adjust if your Jira uses a different Epic Link custom field id or non-searchable Epic link.
Structure `stories` may contain rows not matched by Epic Link JQL — counter reflects Structure children; link reflects Jira Epic-linked issues.
If Issue Navigator rejects the query (field name/id), substitute the working JQL string in each formula CONCAT tail after testing in Advanced Search.

epic_aborted_jql.CR_lane_tail_human: issuetype = "QA Task" AND cf[20572] = "Test cases review"
epic_aborted_jql.TC_lane_tail_human: (issuetype = "QA Task" AND cf[20572] = "Test cases development") OR (issuetype = "Test Execution" AND summary ~ "Test Case Development")
epic_aborted_jql.Validation_lane_tail_human: issuetype = "Test Execution" AND (summary ~ "Epic Validation" OR summary ~ "Epic Testing")

validation_te_closed_skip.intent: If a Validation-column-style Test Execution (*Epic Validation* or *Epic Testing*, type Test Execution) is Closed and this column would otherwise show only the prefilled-create branch (no matching child for that column’s own filter), emit literal Skipped.
validation_te_closed_skip.applies_when: Only when `tctasks.SIZE() = 0` after each snippet’s QA Task / TC filters (not applied when SIZE = 1 or > 1).
validation_te_closed_skip.validation_te_closed_predicate: stories.FILTER(MATCH($.issuetype, "Test Execution") AND $.status = "Closed" AND (MATCH($.summary, "*Epic Validation*") OR MATCH($.summary, "*Epic Testing*"))).SIZE() > 0
validation_te_closed_skip.placement_in_formula: Chained immediately after ELSE for the zero-match branch: `ELSE: IF <validation_te_closed_predicate>: "Skipped" ELSE:` then the existing icon + CreateIssueDetails block.

formula_runtime.engine: ALM Works Structure (column type: Formula, Expr language)

row_context.this: The issue in the current Structure row (formulas gate on Epic only).

wiki_style_output.flag_icons: (flag) and (flagoff) — Structure/Jira wiki-style glyphs used before the create link.
wiki_style_output.create_button: CONCAT(icon, "[+|", url, "]") — plus button linking to prefilled CreateIssueDetails URL.
wiki_style_output.existing_issue_link: CONCAT("[", status, "|", key, "]") when exactly one matching child exists (see inconsistencies for collection vs scalar caveat).

snippets.intent: Ensure a QA Task exists for Test Coverage Review; offer create link if none.
snippets.applies_to: Epic rows only; others render empty string.
skip_conditions: Epic status `Aborted` → `Skipped` or `Skipped ([n|JQL])` (see `epic_aborted_skip`); supersedes qa-no-task / Validation rules for that Epic row.

No matching QA Task for Test cases review (`tctasks.SIZE()` 0): if Validation-pattern Test Execution exists and `Closed`, → literal `Skipped` (see `validation_te_closed_skip`); if a CR ticket exists, show `[status|KEY]` regardless of Validation closed.
snippets.duplicate_and_existing_behavior: Same pattern as other snippets: >1 match → `(!) N`; 1 match → `[status|key]`; 0 → conditional `Skipped` if Validation TE Closed else create branch.

inconsistencies_and_gaps: Epic Testing (any status) early skip remains only on RA and TC; CR ignores that TE except via the gated zero-match Validation-closed path.
Validation omits DEFINED(customfield_61070/customfield_61071) in icon logic unlike CR, RA, TC.
RA parametrizes pid and assignee (qa_pid, qa_alias); CR/TC/Validation hardcode pid 31060 and ct-qa where applicable.
TC uses priority=4 and customfield_11250=16; Validation uses priority=3 and customfield_11250=8 — both create Test Execution (10902) but with different defaults.
Structure editor variables `qa_pld` / `qa_cties` vs repo `qa_pid` / `qa_alias` must be reconciled before editing RA.
Single-match display uses `tctasks.status` and `tctasks.MAP($.key)` — verify Structure guarantees singleton collections for `.status`/`.MAP` semantics when SIZE()=1.

relationship_summary: Each formula gates on Epic, then Epic `Aborted` short-circuits to literal `Skipped` or `Skipped ([n|issues/?jql=…])` before other rules. Else: consult `stories`, then >1 match → (!), 1 match → [status|KEY], 0 matches → conditional Validation-TE Closed `Skipped` or create URL per `validation_te_closed_skip`. RA/TC keep unconditional *Epic Testing* early skip. Iterations frozen under automation/structure/roadmap-columns/versions v01–v04 (see versions-manifest.json). TC and Validation share components, customfield_18082, and Test Execution type but differ in priority and customfield_11250.
